what_was_done: junit_runner.build_suite loads each source-tree test module with loader.loadTestsFromName(name) instead of loadTestsFromModule(importlib.import_module(name)), so an import-broken tally/test_*.py becomes a unittest.loader._FailedTest case of type ImportError in build/junit.xml instead of a runner traceback with no report. Tests: tests/unit/test_sample_runner.py::test_import_broken_source_module_still_writes_the_report (runner level: exit 1, 'Failed to import test module' in stderr, report parses with an ImportError case beside the tests that ran) and ::test_red_survives_an_import_broken_source_module (through the real red gate: the gate names 'build or harness error ... ImportError' and never 'wrote no JUnit report', and the worktree report parses with the ImportError case). Both verified to fail with loadTestsFromName reverted to the old loadTestsFromModule(import_module) call.

junit_runner.build_suite now collects module-level test_ functions in every test module it loads, under tests/ (mirroring discovery's test*.py pattern) and in the source-tree test files. Each function is wrapped in a _FunctionCase (a FunctionTestCase whose id is <module dotted name>.<function name> regardless of interpreter — the stock id on Python 3.14 is the bare function name, which broke the report's classname split), so the report carries classname = the module's dotted name, name = the function name, and the same file attribute a class of that module gets; the criterion rule (ac<N> in the name) therefore works unchanged. A module with a load_tests hook decides for itself; a function imported from another module is collected once, in the module that defines it. A function with required parameters (signature.bind() fails) is reported as an error case whose message says the runner runs unittest cases and plain test functions with no parameters — never dropped. One consequence was absorbed: the scratch builder's tests/test_module.py def test_module() now appears in reports, so test_green_passes_and_writes_patch's pinned suite count went from 10 to 11 (the test it pins always ran but was previously invisible — the under-count the finding describes). Tests: test_sample_runner.py::test_module_level_functions_reach_the_report (passed and failing function cases with their file, criterion AC-1 recognised), ::test_parameter_function_is_reported_as_error (error case of type TypeError naming the rule), and through the real red gate ::test_red_counts_a_module_level_function (a module-level failing test_ac1_extra_red in tests/ is a fourth new red test and covers AC-1, its file frozen). All three verified to fail with the function collection removed. README sentence added to the sample.
where: next/tests/e2e/sample-project/tools/junit_runner.py (build_suite, function_cases, _FunctionCase); next/tests/e2e/sample-project/README.md (one sentence); next/tests/unit/test_gate_green.py (pinned count 10 -> 11); tests: next/tests/unit/test_sample_runner.py

what_was_done: gate_project.make_project now passes the sample directory itself to story_ready.make_project(product=SAMPLE): the staged copy is gone, and the hand-set [paths] with it — story_ready applies the sample's own .factory/factory.toml [paths] (tests, source, repo_config, docs and the empty classes; against the old hand-set keys the only class that changes is docs, from [] to the sample's ["README.md"], which no gate test reads). The [commands] keys it must set stay: the test command through sys.executable, the junit report, and the blanked build/lint/format_check/ui_check/docs_check. Before it returns, make_project loads the project's configuration (_assert_sample_configuration) and asserts delivery.mode == 'local', paths.tests == ['tests/**'] and paths.source == ['tally/**', 'tools/**'], raising AssertionError naming the wrong value. Test: test_sample_runner.py::test_make_project_asserts_the_sample_configuration builds with a monkeypatched story_ready.make_project that leaves paths.source = ['wrong/**'] and expects the AssertionError naming 'paths.source' and 'wrong/**'; verified to fail (did not raise) with the _assert_sample_configuration call removed. The nine gate test files pass with the restructured builder.
